''Fellfire'' and another Star Destroyer|{{Film|VIII}}}} The '''''Fellfire''''' was one of three [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers]] of the [[First Order]] that partook in the [[Battle of D'Qar]] alongside the [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|dreadnought]] ''[[Fulminatrix]]''. [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]] had planned to destroy the [[Resistance]] in a show of might using the [[dreadnought]]'s [[Orbital autocannon|autocannons]] in [[orbit]] of the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]], but [[Resistance pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]] and the [[Resistance Starfighter Corps]]' bravado in taking on the ''Fulminatrix'' by themselves succeeded in eliminating the [[warship]]. While [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE fighters]] launched from the ''Fellfire'' and its fellow [[capital ship]]s crippled the Resistance's force of fighters and [[MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 heavy bomber|bombers]], the [[First Order Navy|First Order flotilla]] failed to vanquish the [[Resistance navy|Resistance fleet]], which fled unscathed. ==Description== {{Quote|I'll be a tiny target for those big cannons of theirs. They'll never hit me.|Poe Dameron, regarding the ''Fellfire'' and the other First Order ships' weaponry|}} As a [[warship]] of the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] model, the ''Fellfire'' measured 2915.84 [[meter]] (9566.29 [[Foot|feet]]) in length, possessed three [[Destroyer Ion Engine]]s and eight [[Gemon-8 ion engine]]s, and was equipped with a [[hyperdrive]]. It also had a [[III-a1a primary hypermatter-annihilation reactor]], a [[deflector shield generator]], [[multi-spectrum sensor tower]]s, [[sensor tower]]s, a [[hyperwave comm scanner]], and [[hangar]] bays. Resistance [[Commander]] [[Poe Dameron]] was confident that the ''Fellfire''{{'s}} large [[laser cannon]]s would fail to hit his [[Black One|X-wing starfighter]] if they engaged in combat. Nevertheless, the [[capital ship]] was able to launch its complement of [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter]]s to counter Resistance [[Starfighter|fighters]]. ==History== ===Fiery ambitions=== {{Quote|''[…]'' they'll all be competing with each other, doing anything they can to make sure it's ''their'' ship that picks me off.|Poe Dameron, voicing his plans for distracting the ''Fellfire'' and other Star Destroyers|}} [[File:ResistanceNavyOverDqar-TLJ.png|thumb|left|360px|The Resistance fleet evacuating D'Qar]] The ''Fellfire'' was a [[First Order]] ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer that accompanied two other [[Starship|vessels]] of its class—including [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]]'s [[flagship]], the ''[[Finalizer]]''—to the [[Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Ileenium system]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' in [[34 ABY]].''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VIII}} to [[34 ABY]]. Following a carefully orchestrated demonstration under Hux's [[Commanding officer|command]], the [[First Order Navy|First Order flotilla]] aimed to destroy the [[Resistance]] at its [[Resistance base|base]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]] and thereby end the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between them and the Resistance in a spectacle that would demonstrate the might of the First Order to the rest of [[the galaxy]]. En route to D'Qar, the [[Star Destroyer]]s' movements were detected by [[Resistance High Command]], who immediately ordered an evacuation of their base. Commander Dameron proposed that he could buy [[time]] for the escape by manning a single [[T-70 X-wing starfighter|X-wing]] and, taking advantage of the First Order commanders' egos, taunt them into attempting to down his fighter, which he would then [[Pilot|fly]] close to the Star Destroyers in order to encourage friendly fire among them. Dameron's [[Black Squadron (Resistance)|Black Squadron]] wanted to join their commander in protecting the [[Resistance navy|Resistance fleet]] and taking on the three Star Destroyers—a plan that [[Resistance pilot|pilot]] [[Jessika Pava]] described as "crazy" if done solo—but General [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] diverted them to another [[Mission to the Outer Rim|mission]]. ===As plans fall through=== {{Quote|How many ships?''"
"''Reading three ''Resurgent''-class Destroyers…and something else. Something…big.|General Leia Organa and a [[Unidentified Resistance tactical officer|Resistance officer]]|[[The Last Jedi Adaptation 1|''The Last Jedi Adaptation'' 1]]}} The ''Fellfire'' and another Resurgent were spotted by Resistance member [[Kaydel Ko Connix]] from the base upon their exit from [[hyperspace]] into D'Qar's [[orbit]], and the two were soon joined by the ''Finalizer'', from which Hux led the siege of D'Qar. General Hux delegated the obliteration of both the Resistance's base and [[fleet]] to the final arrival: the [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought]] ''[[Fulminatrix]]''. Aboard the Resistance [[MC85 Star Cruiser|Star Cruiser]], the ''[[Raddus]]'', the makeup of the [[First Order military|First Order forces]] was promptly gathered by the Resistance via [[Comm/scan processor|comm/scan]] and a corresponding [[Hologram|holographic]] display of them was set up in the [[Bridge (starship)|command bridge]]. [[File:Mandator_IV-class_Siege_Dreadnought.jpg|thumb|right|360px|The ''Fellfire'' was one of four First Order warships that caught the Resistance amid their evacuation.]] With the Resurgents flanking the ''Fulminatrix'' as they moved into positions closer to the Resistance fleet, Dameron attempted to stall the First Order capital ships by hurtling toward them in his lone [[X-wing starfighter|X-wing]] and humiliating "General Hugs" over [[comm unit]]. While he failed to involve the ''Fellfire'' and the other Star Destroyers in combat as the pilot had initially planned, he instead took out all the dorsal [[Point-defense laser cannon|cannons]] on the [[dreadnought]], which destroyed the Resistance's base with its [[Orbital autocannon|autocannons]] only after the last of their transports scurried from D'Qar to join the ''Raddus''. As the ''Fulminatrix''{{'s}} [[Cannon|autocannons]] readied to fire upon that [[MC-series star cruiser|ship]], the dreadnought, which was protected by only its own [[TIE series|TIE fighters]], was [[Battle of D'Qar|approached]] by Resistance [[MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 heavy bomber|bombers]] and their starfighter escort. With [[Captain]] [[Moden Canady]] of the ''Fulminatrix'' having told General Hux that fighters needed to be scrambled earlier when Dameron targeted the dreadnought's [[Weapon|guns]], the ''Fellfire'' and its fellow Destroyers eventually launched more TIEs to counter the threat. Although the onslaught of an overwhelming number of TIEs crippled the [[Resistance Starfighter Corps]], the ''Fulminatrix'' was destroyed. The TIEs pursued the remaining fighters toward the ''Raddus'' and the ''Fellfire'', and the other Destroyers fired at the escaping crafts, but the fleet fled the Ileenium [[Star system|system]] with its [[Star Cruiser|cruiser]] unharmed. The ''Finalizer''''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'' and another Resurgent from the Battle of D'Qar later joined the [[Mega-class Star Dreadnought|dreadnought]] ''[[Supremacy]]'' and its [[Supremacy task force|task force]] of Star Destroyers in [[Battle of Oetchi|hounding]] the Resistance fleet through the [[Oetchi system]]. ==Behind the scenes== The ''Fellfire'' was created for the [[2017]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], and it was named in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: A Junior Novel|junior novelization]] of the film by [[Michael Kogge]]. The novel does not specify which Star Destroyer in the film is the ''Fellfire''. ==Appearances== *{{Film|VIII}} {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Last Jedi: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} {{1stID|''Fellfire''}} *[[The Last Jedi Adaptation 1|''The Last Jedi Adaptation'' 1]] *{{StoryCite|story=Poe's Plan|book=5-Minute Star Wars Stories Strike Back|audiobook=1}} *[[Poe Dameron 28|''Poe Dameron'' 28]] {{Hologram}} {{Flash}} *[[Poe Dameron 29|''Poe Dameron'' 29]] {{Imo}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Fellfire}} *''[[Star Wars: A-wing Deluxe Book and 3D Wood Model]]'' {{Imo}} *''[[Rebel Starfighters Owners' Workshop Manual]]'' {{Imo}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|C-3PO}} {{Imo}} *[[Star Wars Day-at-a-Time Calendar 2022|''Star Wars'' Day-at-a-Time Calendar 2022]] {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Fellfire |ja=フェルファイア |tr=Fellfire }} [[Category:Resurgent-class Star Destroyers]] [[Category:Starships of the First Order]]
